guard will be boosted for a while!

obrana budou na chvili posileny!

be boosted for a while!

{04:10:0E}Mas {Color:Red}Dinin amulet{Color:White}! Tva sila bude
na chvili posilena!

{04:10:0E}You accepted the {Color:Red}Smith's Sword{Color:White}!

Make sure you don't lose this extremely
important delivery!

{04:10:0E}Prevzal jsi {Color:Red}Smithuv mec{Color:White}!

Davej pozor, at neztratis tuhle
nesmirne dulezitou zasilku!

{04:10:0C}You accepted the {Color:Red}Broken Picori Blade{Color:White}!

This is part of the sword needed to
reforge the sacred sword. Don't lose it!
cz:
{04:10:0C}Prevzal jsi {Color:Red}Zlomenou Picori cepel{Color:White}!

Je to cast mece potrebna k vykovani
posvatneho mece. Neztrat ji!

en:
{04:10:0E}You got {Color:Red}a bottle of dog food{Color:White}!
Now, head out on your errand!

{04:10:0E}Mas {Color:Red}lahev psiho zraniva{Color:White}!
A ted vyraz na svuj ukol!

en:
{04:10:0E}You got the {Color:Red}Lon Lon Ranch key{Color:White}!
Now you can open the ranch door!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Mas {Color:Red}klic od ranche Lon Lon{Color:White}!
Ted muzes otevrit dvere ranche!

en:
{04:10:0E}You got a {Color:Red}wake-up mushroom{Color:White}! Its nasty
stench chases away the sleepies!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Mas {Color:Red}probouzeci hribek{Color:White}! Jeho
oskliva vune zazene spanek!

en:
{04:10:0E}You got a library book called
{Color:Red}A Hyrulean Bestiary{Color:White}!

{04:10:0E}You got a library book called
{Color:Red}Legend of the Picori{Color:White}!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Mas knihu z knihovny zvanou
{Color:Red}Legenda o Picori{Color:White}!

en:
{04:10:0E}You got a library book called
{Color:Red}A History of Masks{Color:White}!

{04:10:0E}You got the {Color:Red}graveyard key{Color:White}! Now, you
can open the graveyard gate!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Mas {Color:Red}klic od hrbitova{Color:White}! Ted muzes
otevrit branu hrbitova!

en:
{04:10:0E}You got the {Color:Red}graveyard key {Color:White}back! Now,
you can open the graveyard gate!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Mas {Color:Red}klic od hrbitova {Color:White}zpet! Ted
muzes otevrit branu hrbitova!

en:
You got a {Color:Red}Mysterious Shell{Color:White}! Don't know
what it's for, but hang on to it anyway!
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}Tajemnou ulitu{Color:White}! Nevim, k cemu
je, ale radsi si ji nech!

en:
You've got {Var:1} {Color:Red}Mysterious Shells{Color:White}!

I'm not sure what they're for, but
let's just hold on to them for now.
cz:
Mas {Var:1} {Color:Red}Tajemnych ulit{Color:White}!

Nejsem si jisty, k cemu jsou, ale
zatim si je ponechej.

en:
{04:10:0E}You got the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White}!

The power of the earth is the
source of all living things.
The {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White} is the embodiment
of that power.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Mas {Color:Red}Element zeme{Color:White}!

Sila zeme je zdrojem
veskereho zivota.
{Color:Red}Element zeme{Color:White} je ztelesnenim
teto sily.

en:
{04:10:00}You got the{Color:Red} Fire Element{Color:White}!

Flames bring light to darkness and
warmth to all.
The {Color:Red}Fire Element{Color:White} is the embodiment
of that power.
cz:
{04:10:00}Mas{Color:Red} Element ohne{Color:White}!

Plameny prinaseji svetlo do tmy
a teplo vsem.
{Color:Red}Element ohne{Color:White} je ztelesnenim
teto sily.

en:
{04:10:0E}You got the{Color:Red} Water Element{Color:White}!

Water quenches thirst, ends drought,
and nourishes life.{Color:Blue}
{Color:White}The {Color:Red}Water Element{Color:White} is the embodiment of
that power.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Mas{Color:Red} Element vody{Color:White}!

Voda uhasi zizen, konci sucho
a zivi zivot.{Color:Blue}
{Color:White}{Color:Red}Element vody{Color:White} je ztelesnenim
teto sily.

en:
{04:10:0E}You got the{Color:Red} Wind Element{Color:White}!

The wind carries the seeds of flowers,
scattering life across the land.
The {Color:Red}Wind Element{Color:White} is the embodiment of
that power.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Mas{Color:Red} Element vetru{Color:White}!

Vitr nese semena kvetin
a rozsiva zivot po cele zemi.
{Color:Red}Element vetru{Color:White} je ztelesnenim
teto sily.

en:
{04:10:0E}You got the{Color:Red} Grip Ring{Color:White}!

Now, you can easily climb cliffs that
you could not scale before.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Mas{Color:Red} Prsten uchopu{Color:White}!

Ted snadno vylezes na utesy,
ktere jsi predtim nezvladl.

en:
{04:10:0E}You got the{Color:Red} Power Bracelets{Color:White}! You're
filled with strength, even while tiny!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Mas{Color:Red} Naramky sily{Color:White}! Jsi
plny sily, i kdyz jsi maly!

en:
You got the {Color:Red}flippers{Color:White}! Press {Key:A} to glide
through the water and {Key:B} to dive!
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}plovaci blany{Color:White}! Stiskni {Key:A} pro
klouzani vodou a {Key:B} pro potapeni!

en:
{04:10:0E}You got a {Color:Red}map of Hyrule{Color:White}!
Now, you'll never get lost!

{04:10:0E}You learned the secret {Color:Red}Spin Attack{Color:White}
fighting technique!
This is the first sword technique you've
learned from Master Swiftblade!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Naucil ses tajny utok {Color:Red}Vir mecem{Color:White}!
To je prvni technika mece, kterou
jsi se naucil od Mistra Swiftbladea!

{04:10:0E}Naucil ses tajny utok {Color:Red}Kotoulovy utok{Color:White}!
Zabij jednou ranou! Zacil a uvolni!

{04:10:0E}Naucil ses{Color:Red} {Color:White}tajny utok {Color:Red}Vypadovy utok{Color:White}!
Bez jako vitr a utoc!

en:
{04:10:0E}You learned the secret {Color:Red}Rock Breaker{Color:White}
fighting technique!
Shatter pots and pulverize boulders
with a single blow!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Naucil ses tajny utok {Color:Red}Drtic skal{Color:White}!
Rozbij hrnce a roztris balvany
jednou ranou!

en:
{04:10:0E}You learned the{Color:Red} {Color:White}secret {Color:Red}Sword Beam{Color:White}
fighting technique!
Fire beams from the tip of your blade!

You can only do this when your life
energy is full.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Naucil ses{Color:Red} {Color:White}tajny utok {Color:Red}Paprsek mece{Color:White}!
Vystreluj paprsky ze spicky cepele!

Funguje to jen, kdyz je tvoje
zivotni energie plna.

en:
{04:10:0E}You learned the{Color:Red} {Color:White}secret {Color:Red}Great Spin
Attack {Color:White}fighting technique!
This is it! At last! The ultimate sword
technique!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Naucil ses{Color:Red} {Color:White}tajny utok {Color:Red}Velky vir
mecem{Color:White}!
Uz je to tady! Konecne! Nejvyssi
technika mece!

en:
{04:10:0E}You learned the secret {Color:Red}Down Thrust{Color:White}
fighting technique!
Thrust down with your blade from
midair with this mighty attack!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Naucil ses tajny utok {Color:Red}Bodnuti dolu{Color:White}!
Bodni cepeli dolu ze vzduchu
timto mocnym utokem!

en:
{04:10:0E}You learned the{Color:Red} {Color:White}secret {Color:Red}Peril Beam{Color:White}
fighting technique!
Release a mighty beam from the tip of
your blade! Use it in dire moments!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Naucil ses{Color:Red} {Color:White}tajny utok {Color:Red}Paprsek nouze{Color:White}!
Vypust mocny paprsek ze spicky
cepele! Pouzij ho v krajni nouzi!

en:
{04:10:0E}You found a{Color:Red} dungeon map{Color:White}!
Check it on your {Color:Blue}Map screen{Color:White}.
Lighter rooms are ones you've visited.
The blinking room is your location.
Press Up or Down on {Key:Dpad} to
check different floors.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Nasel jsi{Color:Red} mapu dungeonu{Color:White}!
Prohlizej ji na {Color:Blue}obrazovce Mapy{Color:White}.
Svetlejsi mistnosti jsi navstivil.
Blikajici mistnost je tva pozice.
Stiskni Nahoru nebo Dolu na {Key:Dpad}
pro prohlizeni dalsich pater.

en:
You got the {Color:Red}compass{Color:White}! Use it to find the
locations of hidden items.{Color:Blue}
{Color:White}Press START and then {Key:Left} or {Key:Right} to
view the Map screen.

You got the {Color:Red}Big Key{Color:White}!
Use it to open big doors!
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}velky klic{Color:White}!
Pouzij ho k otevreni velkych dveri!

en:
You got a {Color:Red}small key{Color:White}!

Use it to open locked doors and blocks.
You can use it only in this dungeon.
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}maly klic{Color:White}!

Pouzij ho k otevreni zamcenych
dveri a bloku. Funguje jen tady.

en:
You got {Color:Red}1 Rupee{Color:White}. It's green! Don't
spend it all in one place!
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}1 rupii{Color:White}. Je zelena!
Neutrat ji vsechnu na jednom miste!

en: You got {Color:Red}5 Rupees{Color:White}! That's kind of nice.

You got {Color:Red}50 Rupees{Color:White}!
You must be very happy!
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}50 rupii{Color:White}!
Urcite mas velkou radost!

en:
You got {Color:Red}200 Rupees{Color:White}!
Your face is beaming!

{04:10:0E}You ate the{Color:Red} Jabber Nut{Color:White}! Now you can
understand the language of the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Snedl jsi{Color:Red} Drbavy orisek{Color:White}! Ted rozumis
jazyku {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.

en:
You got a {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White}! These mystic
stones are said to bring happiness.
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}kus Kamene osudu{Color:White}! Rika se,
ze tyto mysticke kameny prinaseji stesti.

en:
You got 5 {Color:Red}bombs{Color:White}! Store them in your
bomb bag!
cz:
Mas 5 {Color:Red}bomb{Color:White}! Uloz si je do
pytle na bomby!

en:
You got 5 {Color:Red}arrows{Color:White}!
Store them in your quiver.
cz:
Mas 5 {Color:Red}sipu{Color:White}!
Uloz si je do toulce.

en:
You got a {Color:Red}heart{Color:White}! These replenish
your life energy a little bit.
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}srdce{Color:White}! Doplnuje ti
zivotni energii o kousek.

en:
You found a {Color:Red}fairy{Color:White}. This reliable ally
will replenish your life energy!
cz:
Nasel jsi {Color:Red}vilu{Color:White}. Tato spolehliva
spojenkyne ti doplni zivotni energii!

en:
You got a {Color:Red}Heart Container{Color:White}!

Your life energy has increased and
been replenished!
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}Nadobu srdce{Color:White}!

Tvoje zivotni energie se zvysila
a byla doplnena!

en:
You got a {Color:Red}big bomb bag{Color:White}! Now you can
carry more bombs!
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}velky pytel na bomby{Color:White}! Ted
muzes nosit vice bomb!

en:
You got a {Color:Red}big wallet{Color:White}! Now, you can
carry more Rupees!
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}velkou penezenku{Color:White}! Ted muzes
nosit vice rupii!

en:
{04:10:00}You got a {Color:Red}bigger bomb bag{Color:White}!

Now, you can carry more bombs!
Let's blow up everything!
cz:
{04:10:00}Mas {Color:Red}vetsi pytel na bomby{Color:White}!

Ted muzes nosit jeste vice bomb!
Pojdme vsechno vyhodit do vzduchu!

en:
You got a {Color:Red}large quiver{Color:White}! Now, you can
carry more arrows!
cz:
Mas {Color:Red}velky toulec{Color:White}! Ted muzes
nosit vice sipu!

en:
{04:10:0E}You got a {Color:Red}Kinstone bag{Color:White}! You can now
carry {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces {Color:White}with you.
Press START to view its contents from
your Quest Status screen.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Mas {Color:Red}pytel na Kameny osudu{Color:White}! Ted
u sebe muzes mit {Color:Red}kusy Kamene osudu{Color:White}.
Stiskni START pro prohlizeni obsahu
v obrazovce Stav vypravy.

en:
You bought a {Color:Red}brioche{Color:White}! It looks so
crusty and delicious!
cz:
Koupil jsi {Color:Red}briosku{Color:White}! Vypada
krupave a chutne!

en:
You bought a {Color:Red}croissant{Color:White}! It looks so
buttery and delicious!
cz:
Koupil jsi {Color:Red}kroasan{Color:White}! Vypada
maslove a chutne!

en:
You bought a {Color:Red}slice of pie{Color:White}! One bite,
and you're in heaven!
cz:
Koupil jsi {Color:Red}kousek kolace{Color:White}! Jedno
sousto a jsi v nebi!

en:
You bought a {Color:Red}slice of cake{Color:White}!
Time to get your snack on!
cz:
Koupil jsi {Color:Red}kousek dortu{Color:White}!
Cas na svacinu!

en:
You bought 10{Color:Red} bombs{Color:White}!
Store them in your bomb bag!
cz:
Koupil jsi 10{Color:Red} bomb{Color:White}!
Uloz si je do pytle na bomby!

en:
You bought 30{Color:Red} bombs{Color:White}!

cz:

Koupil jsi 30{Color:Red} sipu{Color:White}!
Uloz si je do toulce!

en:
You caught a {Color:Red}Joy Butterfly{Color:White}! You can
now shoot arrows faster than before.
cz:
Chytil jsi {Color:Red}Motyla radosti{Color:White}! Ted
umis strilet sipy rychleji nez driv.

en:
You caught a {Color:Red}Joy Butterfly{Color:White}! You can
now dig faster than before!
cz:
Chytil jsi {Color:Red}Motyla radosti{Color:White}! Ted
umis kopat rychleji nez driv!

en:
You caught a {Color:Red}Joy Butterfly{Color:White}! You can
now swim faster than before!
cz:
Chytil jsi {Color:Red}Motyla radosti{Color:White}! Ted
umis plavat rychleji nez driv!

en:
This is it! You {Color:Red}sped up your
Great Spin Attack charge{Color:White}!
You won't have to hold the button
down as long anymore!
cz:
Je to tady! {Color:Red}Zrychlil jsi nabijeni
Velkeho viru mecem{Color:White}!
Uz nebudes muset drzet tlacitko
tak dlouho!

en:
This is it! Your {Color:Red}Split Gauge {Color:White}has
been {Color:Red}sped up{Color:White}!
Your sword gauge will fill with power
more quickly!

Je to tady! Tvuj {Color:Red}Ukazatel mece {Color:White}byl
{Color:Red}zrychlen{Color:White}!
Ukazatel mece se ti naplni silou
rychleji!

en:
This is it! Your {Color:Red}Great Spin Attack
rotation time {Color:White}has {Color:Red}increased{Color:White}!
Spin around and smash enemies to bits!
cz:
Je to tady! Tvuj cas rotace
{Color:Red}Velkeho viru mecem {Color:White}se {Color:Red}prodlouzil{Color:White}!
Toc se a roztris nepratele na kusy!

en:
{04:10:0E}Welcome to the adventurer's spring...

I have need of many Rupees... Please,
throw all of yours into the spring.
{Choice:05:7C}Sure  {Choice:05:7D}No way
cz:
{04:10:0E}Vitej u pramene dobrodruhu...

Potrebuji mnoho rupii... Prosim,
hod vsechny sve do pramene.
{Choice:05:7C}Jasne  {Choice:05:7D}V zadnem pripade

en:
{04:10:0E}{04:10:0E}Really?

You know that, if you do this, you will
have absolutely no Rupees left, right?
Will you really throw them all in?
{Choice:05:7E}Yes  {Choice:05:7D}No
cz:
{04:10:0E}{04:10:0E}Opravdu?

Vis, ze pokud to udelas, nezbude ti
uplne zadna rupie, ze?
Fakt je tam vsechny hodis?
{Choice:05:7E}Ano  {Choice:05:7D}Ne

en:
{04:10:0E}{04:10:0E}I see. Then I will wait for the next
adventurer who comes my way...
cz:
{04:10:0E}{04:10:0E}Chapu. Pak pockam na dalsiho
dobrodruha, ktery se sem dostane...

en:
{04:10:0E}You are most kind. I do not
really need your Rupees.
But I must reward such a kind
adventurer with some of my power.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Jsi velmi laskavy. Vlastne
tve rupie nepotrebuji.
Musim ale tak laskaveho dobrodruha
odmenit casti sve moci.

en:
{04:10:0E}Welcome to the adventurer's spring...

Did you throw the {Color:Red}Golden Bomb{Color:White} into
the spring? Or the {Color:Red}Silver Bomb{Color:White}?
{Choice:05:81}Golden Bomb    {Choice:05:81}Silver Bomb
{Choice:05:82}Neither
cz:
{04:10:0E}Vitej u pramene dobrodruhu...

Hodil jsi do pramene {Color:Red}Zlatou bombu{Color:White}?
Nebo {Color:Red}Stribrnou bombu{Color:White}?
{Choice:05:81}Zlatou bombu    {Choice:05:81}Stribrnou bombu
{Choice:05:82}Ani jednu

en:
{04:10:0E}You're lying, aren't you?

As punishment for your lie, I will reduce
your number of bombs to zero.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Lzes, ze?

Jako trest za tvou lez ti snizim
pocet bomb na nulu.

en:
{04:10:0E}You are honest.

I must reward such an honest
adventurer with some of my power.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Jsi upimny.

Musim tak upimneho dobrodruha
odmenit casti sve moci.

en:
{04:10:0E}Welcome to the adventurer's spring.

Would you tell me of the things you've
seen on your adventures?
{Choice:FF}Yes  {Choice:FF}Not now
cz:
{04:10:0E}Vitej u pramene dobrodruhu.

Reknes mi o tom, co jsi videl
na svych dobrodruzstvich?
{Choice:FF}Ano  {Choice:FF}Ted ne

en:
{04:10:0E}The first element you found was the
Fire Element, was it not?
{Choice:05:8A}Yes  {Choice:05:8C}No
cz:
{04:10:0E}Prvni element, ktery jsi nasel, byl
Element ohne, je to tak?
{Choice:05:8A}Ano  {Choice:05:8C}Ne

en:
{04:10:0E}Your grandfather's name is Smee,
isn't it?
{Choice:05:8A}Yes  {Choice:05:8D}No
cz:
{04:10:0E}Tvuj dedecek se jmenuje Smee,
je to tak?
{Choice:05:8A}Ano  {Choice:05:8D}Ne

en:
{04:10:0E}Melari of Mount Crenel has seven
apprentices, does he not?
{Choice:05:8E}Yes  {Choice:05:8A}No
cz:
{04:10:0E}Melari z hory Crenel ma sedm
ucnu, je to tak?
{Choice:05:8E}Ano  {Choice:05:8A}Ne

en:
{04:10:0E}The Blabber Nut gives one the ability
to understand the Minish, does it not?
{Choice:05:8A}Yes  {Choice:05:8F}No
cz:
{04:10:0E}Drbavy orisek dava schopnost
rozumet Minish, je to tak?
{Choice:05:8A}Ano  {Choice:05:8F}Ne

en:
{04:10:0E}The robe of the current king of Hyrule,
Daltus, is white, is it not?
{Choice:05:8A}Yes  {Choice:05:8B}No
cz:
{04:10:0E}Plast soucasneho krale Hyrule,
Daltuse, je bily, je to tak?
{Choice:05:8A}Ano  {Choice:05:8B}Ne

en:
{04:10:0E}You have lied to me.

As punishment for your lie, I will reduce
your number of arrows to zero.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Lhal jsi mi.

Jako trest za tvou lez ti snizim
pocet sipu na nulu.

en:
{04:10:0E}I see. Thank you for telling me about
your quest. You remember it all so well.
Such a faithful memory should be
rewarded with some of my power.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Chapu. Dekuji, ze jsi mi povedel
o sve vyprave. Tak dobre si vse pamatujes.
Tak verna pamet by mela byt
odmenena casti me moci.

en:
{04:10:0E}Welcome to the adventurer's spring...
Let me rest your weary body.
cz:
{04:10:0E}Vitej u pramene dobrodruhu...
Nech me odpocinout tve unavene telo.

        Lakeside Cabin
cz:

        Hagena u jezera

en:
Dear Mom,
I'll be next door if you need me.
cz:
Mila mami,
budu vedle, kdybys me potrebovala.

en:
This week's top titles:

{Symbol:10}3   Learn to Like Your Like Like:
     A Good Guide to a Bad Pet
{Symbol:10}2   Gorman's Guide to Good Grub

{Symbol:10}1   Married to the Moblin
cz:
Tento tyden nejlepsi tituly:

{Symbol:10}3   Nauc se mit rad sveho Like Like:
     Dobry pruvodce spatnym mazlickem
{Symbol:10}2   Gormanuv pruvodce dobrym zranim

{Symbol:10}1   Vdana za Moblina

en:
Hagen's Words of Wisdom

If you can't solve a problem, just ram
headlong into it. BAM!
cz:
Hagenova slova moudrosti

Kdyz nemuzes vyresit problem, tak
do nej vraz hlavou. PRAC!

en:
{Symbol:0A}  Mayor Hagen's Lakeside Cabin
All digging absolutely prohibited!
cz:
{Symbol:0A}  Chata starosty Hagena u jezera
Veskere kopani prisne zakazano!

en:
Under construction.
All digging strictly prohibited!
cz:
Ve vystavbe.
Veskere kopani prisne zakazano!

en:
Beware crumbling walls!
Blasting strictly prohibited.
cz:
Pozor na drolici se zdi!
Odstreloani prisne zakazano.

en:
The truth about the {Color:Red}light force{Color:White} within{Color:Red}
{Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White} is depicted here.
cz:
Pravda o {Color:Red}sile svetla{Color:White} v{Color:Red}
{Color:Green}princezne Zelde{Color:White} je zde zobrazena.

en:
The way forward is hidden
in the bottom of the pot.
cz:
Cesta vpred je skryta
ve dne hrnce.

en:
You've finally fused all of the {Color:Red}Kinstone
pieces{Color:White}! Go speak to {Color:Green}Grandpa Smith{Color:White}!
cz:
Konecne jsi spojil vsechny {Color:Red}kusy
Kamene osudu{Color:White}! Jdi za {Color:Green}dedeckem Smithem{Color:White}!

en:
The two {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces {Color:White}fit perfectly!
Maybe something good will happen!
cz:
Ty dva {Color:Red}kusy Kamene osudu {Color:White}do sebe
perfektne zapadly! Mozna se neco dobreho stane!

en:
A young boy who lives in Hyrule. He is
close friends with Princess Zelda.
cz:
Mlady chlapec, ktery zije v Hyrule.
Je blizkym pritelem princezny Zeldy.

en:
A young boy on a quest with Ezlo to
restore the Four Sword.
With the sword's power, he hopes to
remove the curse on Princess Zelda.
cz:
Mlady chlapec, ktery s Ezlem vyrazil
obnovit Ctyrmec.
Silou mece doufa, ze zlomi
kletbu na princezne Zelde.

en:
A bright and cheery princess from
Hyrule's royal family.
She loves to sneak out of the castle
to visit her good friend, {Player}.
cz:
Bystra a vesela princezna
z kralovske rodiny Hyrule.
Rada se vyplizi z hradu, aby
navstivila sveho pritele {Player}.

en:
A strange creature that looks at first
like a cap. He speaks roughly and
treats {Player} like a child, but he
actually really likes {Player}.
cz:
Podivny tvor, ktery na prvni pohled
vypada jako cepice. Mluvi hrube a
zachazi s {Player} jako s ditetem,
ale ve skutecnosti ho ma rad.

en:
When the young Minish donned Ezlo's
magic cap, he took this evil form. Now,
he searches for the light force in his
quest to become all-powerful.
cz:
Kdyz mlady Minish nasadil Ezloovu
kouzelnou cepici, ziskal tuto zlou
podobu. Hleda silu svetla, aby se
stal vsemocnym.

en:
The king of Hyrule. Reported to have
been a fine swordsman, he appeared in
the Picori Festival tournament as a
youth and fought to a draw with Smith.
cz:
Kral Hyrule. Pry byl vyborny sermir,
v mladi se objevil na turnaji
Festivalu Piccoru a remizoval
se Smithem.

en:
The supporting pillar of Hyrule. He
is also in charge of Princess Zelda's
education, so when she goes missing,
he gets frustrated.
cz:
Nosny pilir Hyrule. Ma na starosti
vychovu princezny Zeldy, takze
kdyz zmizi, dostane se do
frustrace.

en:
The finest swordsmith in Hyrule. As a
young man, he was a great swordsman.
He and King Daltus are friends and
enjoyed a pleasant rivalry as youths.
cz:
Nejlepsi mecir v Hyrule. Jako mlady
byl skvelym sermirem. S kralem
Daltusem jsou pratele a v mladi
spolu meli pratelskou rivalitu.

en:
The mayor of the town of Hyrule. He's a
big collector of odd masks. He's built a
shelter into his garden just in case
monsters ever attack Hyrule.
cz:
Starosta mesta Hyrule. Velky sberatel
podivnych masek. Postavil si v
zahrade kryt pro pripad, ze by
nekdy zautocily prisery.

en:
Second in command at Hyrule's post
office. She's mellow and laid-back,
entirely unlike the high-strung and
easily excitable Stamp.
cz:
Druha v poradi na poste Hyrule.
Je klidna a uvolnena, naprosto
jina nez nervozni a snadno
rozculitelny Stamp.

en:
A busy, hardworking postal employee,
although he can be a touch edgy.
The stamp he uses is his own personal
one, so please don't borrow it. Thanks.
cz:
Zaneprazdneny, pracovity zamestnanec
posty, i kdyz muze byt trochu
nervozni. Razitko, ktere pouziva,
je jeho vlastni, takze si ho neber.

en:
The proprietor of {Color:Blue}Rem's Shoe Store{Color:White}.
Using his "secret technique," he makes
shoes in his sleep. Princess Zelda is
his single biggest source of income.
cz:
Majitel {Color:Blue}Remova obchodu s botami{Color:White}.
Diky svemu "tajnemu triku" vyrabi
boty ve spanku. Princezna Zelda
je jeho nejvetsim zdrojem prijmu.

en:
A gruff-talking academic type who is
obsessed with studying the Picori.
He doesn't seem to be aware that they
are actually living in his own house.
cz:
Drsne mluvici akademicky typ, ktery
je posedly studiem Picori.
Zda se, ze netusi, ze ve skutecnosti
ziji v jeho vlastnim dome.

en:
A sculptor of finely crafted {Color:Blue}figurines{Color:White}.
Many consider him the best sculptor
in all of Hyrule. He enjoys collecting
{Color:Blue}Mysterious Shells{Color:White}.
cz:
Socha jemne vyrabenych {Color:Blue}figurek{Color:White}.
Mnozi ho povazuji za nejlepsiho
sochare v cele Hyrule. Rad sbira
{Color:Blue}Tajemne ulity{Color:White}.

en:
Owner of the {Color:Blue}Chest Mini-Game Shop{Color:White}.
Carlov's younger brother. He detests
gambling, but he has made the biggest
gamble of all: entrepreneurship.
cz:
Majitel {Color:Blue}obchodu s mini-hrou truhel{Color:White}.
Mladsi bratr Carlova. Hazardni hry
nenavidi, ale udelal nejvetsi
sazku ze vsech: podnikani.

en:
The handy neighborhood gear seller,
also called {Color:Blue}Stockwell the Well-Stocked{Color:White}.
He complains that he's been too busy
lately to see his dog, Fifi.
cz:
Sikovny sousedsky prodejce vybaveni,
take zvany {Color:Blue}Stockwell Dobre Zasobeny{Color:White}.
Stezuje si, ze je posledni dobou
prilis zaneprazdnen na svou fenku Fifi.

en:
His mysterious {Color:Blue}dungeon-simulation
game{Color:White} is very popular in Hyrule. It gives
players the illusion of fighting real
monsters in real dungeons.
cz:
Jeho zahadna {Color:Blue}hra simulace dungeonu{Color:White}
je v Hyrule velmi oblibena. Da
hracum iluzi boje se skutecnymi
priserami v opravdovych dungeonech.

en:
He wants to rent out his house in town,
but he's too overbearing to attract
a tenant. He doesn't even seem to
realize what the problem is...
cz:
Chce pronajmout svuj dum ve meste,
ale je prilis dotery, aby prilakal
najemnika. Zda se, ze ani neuvedomuje,
v cem je problem...

en:
This young woman tends to her cuccos
in Hyrule Town.
If you help her gather her loose
cuccos, she'll give you a reward.
cz:
Tato mlada zena se stara o sva
cucca v meste Hyrule.
Pokud ji pomuzes posbirat utekla
cucca, da ti odmenu.

en:
Hyrule's vegetable vendor. He sells fine
produce. He also argues constantly
with the fruit vendor, Pina, over
the health benefits of vegetables.
cz:
Hyrulsky prodejce zeleniny. Prodava
kvalitni produkty. Take se neustale
hada s prodejkyni ovoce Pinou
o zdravotnich vyhodach zeleniny.

en:
Hyrule's fruit vendor. She hates
vegetables, so she won't even sell
tomatoes, even though they
technically ARE fruits. Freak.
cz:
Hyrulska prodejkyne ovoce. Nesnasi
zeleninu, takze ani neprodava
rajcata, i kdyz technicky
JSOU ovocem. Podivinka.

en:
Though he is an adult, he is very good
at finding Picolyte made by the Minish.
And he is very, VERY convincing about
their healthful properties.
cz:
Prestoze je dospely, je vyborny
v hledani Picolytu od Minish.
A je velmi, VELMI presvedcivy o
jejich zdravotnich vlastnostech.

en:
A very serious mail deliveryman.
He continues to make every delivery
right on time every day.
cz:
Velmi vazny donaska posty.
Kazdy den pokracuje v dorucovani
vsech zasilek presne na cas.

en:
A hermit who lives on Mount Crenel.
He has lots of Kinstone pieces.
He brags that he won the festival 
tournament when he was younger.
cz:
Poustevnik, ktery zije na Mt. Crenel.
Ma hodne kusu Kamene osudu.
Chlubi se, ze vyhral turnaj
festivalu, kdyz byl mladsi.

en:
A weird old lady living in Percy's
house without his permission.
She doesn't want you to turn on the
lights. She might actually be a...
cz:
Podivna stara pani bydli v Percyho
dome bez jeho povoleni.
Nechce, abys rozsvitil svetla.
Mozna je ve skutecnosti...

en:
The gravedigger at the cemetery.
They say he has the power to speak
with the dead. He fuses the Kinstones
he digs up with the local ghosts.
cz:
Hrobnik na hrbitove.
Rikaji, ze ma moc mluvit s
mrtvymi. Spojuje Kameny osudu,
ktere vykopal, s mistnimi duchy.

en:
The spirit of an ancient king of Hyrule
who wishes to secure peace in his land
from beyond the grave. He was very
fond of the people of the Wind Tribe.
cz:
Duch starovekeho krale Hyrule, ktery
si preje zajistit mir ve sve zemi
i za hrobem. Velmi si oblibil
lidi z Kmene vetru.

en:
A wizard who lives in the Minish Woods.
She sells magic items with odd powers.
She's looking for an apprentice to whom
she can teach her mystic spells.
cz:
Carodejka, ktera zije v Minish Lesich.
Prodava magicke predmety s podivnymi
silami. Hleda ucnice, ktere by
mohla naucit sva mysticka kouzla.

en:
The Great Butterfly Fairy of Minish
Woods. She provides you with a
larger wallet, allowing you to carry
more Rupees with you.
cz:
Velka motyli vila z Minish Lesu.
Da ti vetsi penezenku, diky ktere
muzes nosit vice rupii.

en:
The Great Mayfly Fairy of Mount
Crenel. She provides you with a larger
bomb bag, allowing you to carry more
bombs with you.
cz:
Velka jepici vila z Mt. Crenel.
Da ti vetsi pytel na bomby,
diky kteremu muzes nosit
vice bomb.

en:
The Great Dragonfly Fairy of Royal
Valley. She gives you a larger
quiver, allowing you to carry
more arrows with you.
cz:
Velka vazcina vila z Kralovskeho
udoli. Da ti vetsi toulec,
diky kteremu muzes nosit
vice sipu.

en:
A poet who lives in Western Wood.
He comes home from a long journey to
find his house occupied by an unwanted
guest. Poor guy...
cz:
Basnik, ktery zije v Zapadnim lese.
Vraci se domu z dlouhe cesty a
zjisti, ze jeho dum obsadil
nezvany host. Chudak...

en:
She's looking for a house in Hyrule
to move into. She is descended from
a line of oracles in the land of
Labrynna.
cz:
Hleda dum v Hyrule, kam by se
nastehovala. Pochazi z rodu
orakulu ze zeme
Labrynna.

en:
She's looking for a house in Hyrule to
move into. She's a very helpful person,
but people take advantage of her kind
nature. This really bothers her.
cz:
Hleda dum v Hyrule, kam by se
nastehovala. Je velmi ochotna,
ale lide zneuzivaji jeji
laskave povahy. To ji vadi.

en:
She's looking for a house in Hyrule to
move into. She is a famous dancer from
the land of Holodrum.
cz:
Hleda dum v Hyrule, kam by se
nastehovala. Je slavnou tanecnici
ze zeme Holodrum.

en:
A rare butterfly said to bring
happiness to those who catch it.
If you see one on your journeys,
try to grab it!
cz:
Vzacny motyl, o kterem se rika,
ze prinese stesti tem, kdo ho
chyti. Pokud ho na svych cestach
uvidis, zkus ho chytit!

en:
A strange Ghini who wants to fuse
Kinstone pieces, which is somewhat
peculiar for a monster. She has a lot
of pieces, so keep on fusing!
cz:
Podivny Ghini, ktery chce spojovat
kusy Kamene osudu, coz je na priseru
dost neobvykle. Ma hodne kusu,
tak spojuj dal!

en:
A Minish living in Minish Village. He
speaks some human languages. He sees
that {Player} is human with one look.
He's a bit of a human enthusiast.
cz:
Minish zijici v Minish vesnici.
Mluvi nekolika lidskymi jazyky. Na
prvni pohled pozna, ze {Player} je
clovek. Je trochu nadsenec do lidi.

en:
The elder of the Forest Minish. He has
lived among humans for a long time. He
knows where the four elements are. He
has a twin brother in Hyrule's library.
cz:
Starsi z Lesnich Minish. Dlouho
zil mezi lidmi. Vi, kde jsou
ctyri elementy. Ma dvojceci bratra
v knihovne Hyrule.

en:
Not visible to the eyes of adults, they
delight in making humans happy by
hiding helpful items and Rupees under
grass and rocks all over the world.
cz:
Neviditelni pro oci dospelych, baveni
je delani lidi stastnymi tim, ze
skryvaji uzitecne predmety a rupie
pod travou a kameny po celem svete.

en:
This Town Minish elder is Gentari's
twin brother. Those large wings that he
is so proud of are trophies from a duel
with a cucco as a young Minish.
cz:
Tento starsi Mestskych Minish je
Gentariho dvojce. Ta velka kridla,
na ktera je tak hrdy, jsou trofeje
ze souboje s cuccem v mladi.

en:
These Minish like humans so much that
they moved from Minish Village into
Hyrule itself! They try to make humans
happy, but it sometimes backfires.
cz:
Tito Minish maji lidi tak radi, ze
se prestehovali z Minish vesnice
priamo do Hyrule! Snazi se delat
lidi stastnymi, ale obcas to selze.

en:
He lives with his seven apprentices in
Mount Crenel, which contains all the
mineral riches they will ever need.
He seems gruff, but he's trustworthy.
cz:
Zije se svymi sedmi ucni na
Mt. Crenel, ktery obsahuje vsechno
mineralni bohatstvi, ktere kdy budou
potrebovat. Pusobi drsne, ale je verny.

en:
These seven students followed Melari
from Minish Village to Mount Crenel.
Their song is actually a sign that they
are full-fledged Mountain Minish now.
cz:
Techto sedm zaku nasledovalo Melariho
z Minish vesnice na Mt. Crenel.
Jejich pisen je vlastne znamenim, ze
uz jsou plnohodnotnymi Horskymi Minish.

en:
These rock- and iron-eaters once
lived on Mount Crenel in Western
Hyrule. Now their numbers are few, and
they live quietly in a cave.
cz:
Tito pozirace kamene a zeleza kdysi
zili na Mt. Crenel v Zapadnim
Hyrule. Ted je jich malo a tise
ziji v jeskyni.

en:
Before he became a sorcerer, he was
a simple Minish. He had always been
entranced by the evil that lives in
the hearts of men...
cz:
Nez se stal carodejem, byl prostym
Minish. Vzdy byl uchvacen zlem,
ktere zije v srdcich lidi...

en:
These vassals serve the king of
Hyrule. They are loyal and diligent.
Like the king himself, they are
courteous yet frank.
cz:
Tito vazalove slouzi krali Hyrule.
Jsou verni a pilni. Stejne jako
sam kral jsou zdvorili, ale
upimni.

en:
The Royal Hyrule Library. Although
the library is well loved, many forget
to return their books, causing no end
of trouble for the librarians.
cz:
Kralovska knihovna Hyrule. Prestoze
je knihovna velmi oblibena, mnozi
zapominaji vracet knihy, coz
zpusobuje knihovnikum potize.

en:
All of these self-trained swordsmen
have won the fighting tournament at
the Picori Festival before. They see
great potential in {Player}.
cz:
Vsichni tito sermiri-samouci uz
v minulosti vyhrali bojovy turnaj
na Festivalu Piccoru. Vidi v
{Player} velky potencial.

en:
This couple bakes bread in Hyrule.
Their tasty pastries hold a secret...
If you're extra lucky, there'll
be a helpful item hidden inside!
cz:
Tento par peče chleba v Hyrule.
Jejich chutne peciva skryvaji
tajemstvi... Kdyz mas stesti,
uvnitr bude uzitecny predmet!

en:
This is where all the children of Hyrule
learn. {Player} and Princess Zelda
studied here, too. The two teachers
are twins named Tina and Dina.
cz:
Tady se uci vsechny deti Hyrule.
{Player} a princezna Zelda se zde
take ucili. Obe ucitelky jsou
dvojcata jmenem Tina a Dina.

en:
This is the best place in town to relax.
You can also pick up some good tips,
from the latest gossip to observations
about the world.
cz:
Toto je nejlepsi misto ve meste
k odpocinku. Muzes zde take ziskat
uzitecne tipy, od nejnovejsich drbu
po pozorovani sveta.

en:
This generous inn gives a gift to
every guest who stays the night.
Guests can unwind in the lobby on
the second floor.
cz:
Tento stedry hostinec dava dar
kazdemu hostovi, ktery prespi.
Hoste mohou odpocivat v hale
ve druhem patre.

en:
Zill's the one with the drippy nose. He
likes to wander around town with his
friends. He knows a lot about Hyrule,
and he might even give you some tips!
cz:
Zill je ten s kapajicim nosem. Rad
se toula po meste se svymi prateli.
Vi hodne o Hyrule a mozna ti
dokonce da nejake tipy!

en:
These carpenters may be rough around
the edges, but they do good work.
They may seem tough, but they're
in touch with their feminine side.
cz:
Tito truhlari mohou byt drsni,
ale delaji dobrou praci.
Mohou vypadat tvrde, ale jsou
v kontaktu se svou jemnou strankou.

en:
Romio and Julietta grew up next door
to one another. They're dating now,
but they plan to marry once they get
their pets' approval.
cz:
Romio a Julietta vyrustali vedle
sebe. Ted spolu chodi, ale planuji
se vzit, az dostanou souhlas
od svych mazlicku.
